u0: The agent has made no progress yet: the matching key has not been taken, the locked door has not been opened, and the target box is not held. The agent must get the key, use it to open the door, and only afterward pick up the designated box in the other room. Taking the key also obliges the agent to open the door before finishing.
u1: The designated box was picked up before the locked door had ever been opened, breaking the required door-before-box order. This is a terminal failure: the mandatory requirement has been violated, so successful completion is no longer possible.
u2: The matching key has been taken while the door was still closed, so opening that door is now required. The target box is still unpicked, and the door must be opened before the box is collected. If the key is no longer in hand, it must be recovered before the door can be unlocked.
u3: The door has been opened and the matching key is not currently in hand, while the designated box has not yet been picked up. The remaining objective is to reach the other room and pick up the box; if the door has since been closed and the box room has not yet been reached, the key must be recovered and the door reopened.
u4: The designated box has been picked up after the door was opened, satisfying the required order and all completion conditions. The mission is complete, there is nothing left to do, and the episode ends.
u5: The door has already been opened, and the target box has not yet been picked up; the matching key may still be in hand. The remaining objective is to pick up the designated box, and if the key is still held it must be released first so the hands are free. If the door has been closed again, it may need to be reopened before returning to the box room.
